question: Can every frozen F1 factor tensor and bound camera receipt be mapped by a zero-parameter deterministic outside-graph adapter into every F0 reducer field without final-task shortcuts, silent imputation or uncertainty-strengthening drift?
principle: The adapter translates declared factor evidence into reducer evidence; it may neither invent missing factors nor decide the final task state.

data_partitions.identity_basis: Eight deterministic tiny tensor cases frozen before any adapter implementation or canary execution.

identity_equalities: calibration_receipt.factor_schema_sha256 == frozen F1 factor schema SHA256
frame_contract.tensor_shape_rule: Every HxW prediction tensor has exactly geometry_receipt.tensor_hw; no resize occurs inside the adapter.
frame_contract.k_rule: K is finite display-upright tensor K with fx>0, fy>0, 0<=cx<W and 0<=cy<H; orientation is exactly portrait or landscape.
frame_contract.gravity_rule: gravity_up_camera is finite unit length within 1e-6 when gravity_valid=true.
frame_contract.receipt_failure: Emit a complete F0 frame with k_valid=false and transform_valid=false so the frozen reducer returns UNKNOWN; never repair, infer or substitute K/transform/gravity.
frame_contract.factor_identity_rule: Copy factor_identity byte-semantically and require learned_final_task_head=false.

numeric_contract.coverage_formula: count(evidence_valid_hw AND all declared evidence/depth values finite) / (H*W)
numeric_contract.uncertainty_monotonicity: Increasing any declared sigma or decreasing any validity/probability without new positive evidence may preserve or weaken reducer evidence but may never strengthen OCCUPIED or convert UNKNOWN to CLEAR.

operations.rule: Validate all frame equalities, tensor shapes, K, transform, gravity and orientation; coverage uses the frozen all-pixel denominator.
scale_m=exp(log_metric_scale_m_scalar) iff metric_scale_valid and finite; otherwise valid=false.
metric_depth_m_hw=depth_shape_positive_hw*scale_m; all valid shape values must be finite and >0.

For pixels with depth_valid_probability>=0.5, relative_sigma=exp(depth_log_sigma)/metric_depth; scale_relative_sigma=clip(q50(relative_sigma), receipt floor, receipt cap); scale_sigma_m=scale_m*scale_relative_sigma.
Pass the finite unit normal only when support_valid=true and at least one finite support_probability>=0.5; otherwise support.valid=false.
Copy the nonnegative fit-only calibration value; it is not inferred from task outcome or reducer state.
Copy finite camera_height_m>0 only when support_valid=true.
Copy the nonnegative fit-only calibration value; it is independent of final task outcome.
Copy the finite nonnegative declared residual sigma only when support_valid=true.

Candidate mask is evidence_valid AND obstacle_evidence_probability>=0.5; extract deterministic 8-connected components. Boundary probability remains an evidence input and does not create a component alone.
Component depth_valid=true iff every component pixel has finite depth_valid_probability>=0.5; missing depth is retained as depth_valid=false and never imputed as occupied.
depth_shape_forward=q10(valid component shape); per-pixel shape_sigma=exp(depth_log_sigma)/scale_m; depth_shape_sigma=q90(per-pixel shape_sigma).
Back-project every component pixel's u-0.5 and u+0.5 edges as x=(u-cx)*depth/fx; take finite min/max, center=(lo+hi)/2 and half_width=(hi-lo)/2.
evidence_probability=min(q50(obstacle probability),q50(boundary probability)) over the component; boundary confidence can only weaken evidence.
Sort by (depth_valid false last, depth_shape_forward, lateral_center_m, topmost_row, leftmost_col) with invalid numeric sentinels last; component enumeration order is never observable.

mutation_canary_gates.condition: All 14 frozen F1 prediction fields have declared consumers and every required F0 frame/obstacle field has one producer.
Identical tensor and receipts produce byte-identical ordered F0 frames.
Increasing depth uncertainty cannot strengthen occupancy evidence or turn UNKNOWN into CLEAR.
Invalid support or absent normal/height calibration makes support invalid and reducer output UNKNOWN.
Split, bridge-merge and enumeration-order mutations preserve 8-connectivity and canonical ordering.
mutation_canary_gates.pass: frozen component counts and order match

mutation_canary_gates.condition: Portrait and landscape display-upright K fixtures yield the same central-obstacle reducer state map.
Missing component depth stays depth_valid=false and cannot become OCCUPIED.
mutation_canary_gates.pass: no occupied state in affected band

mutation_canary_gates.condition: Increasing any sigma alone never increases evidence lower bound or definite occupancy.
Adapter has zero trainable parameters, remains outside the learned graph and rejects final-task keys recursively.

prohibited_artifacts_in_this_lock: any model, trainer, optimizer, checkpoint or label materializer

unique_successor.scope: Implement only this zero-parameter adapter, run the eight frozen synthetic cases and A01-A10, and write a new versioned CANARY_LITE result. Do not read real data or task outcome and do not create any model, trainer or checkpoint.

frozen_now: three input schemas and exact frame identity equalities
eight-case synthetic fixture and ten canary gates
unresolved_before_successor_execution: canary runner and focused test SHA
versioned output root and resource receipt
still_blocked_after_adapter_canary: complete supervision source and label contract
parent-disjoint F1 roster, model and training authority

constraints.description: Every frozen prediction field and reducer field is explicitly covered.
constraints.rationale: Prevents silent field loss or adapter invention.
constraints.calibration_source: Byte-frozen F1 schema and F0 reducer interface.
constraints.revision_policy: Any field change requires a new adapter protocol version.

constraints.description: No final-task field, trainable parameter, reducer gradient or outcome input may enter the adapter.
Missing evidence or increased uncertainty may not create stronger positive evidence or a clearer state.
constraints.rationale: Keeps UNKNOWN fail-closed across the tensor-to-reducer seam.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No violations are allowed in the frozen synthetic family.
constraints.revision_policy: A semantic change requires a new hypothesis version.

constraints.description: Protocol or canary PASS cannot authorize real F1 data, model definition or training.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Run eight tiny synthetic tensor cases and A01-A10 against the byte-frozen F0 reducer.
experiment_design.baseline: Current hard blocker: no FactorTensorAdapter contract or implementation.
experiment_design.treatment: One deterministic zero-parameter adapter implementing the 17 frozen operations.
experiment_design.counterfactual: Mutate field coverage, uncertainty, receipt identity, component topology, orientation or task-shortcut boundaries one at a time.
experiment_design.primary_comparison: Exact expected adapter/reducer behavior on eight frozen synthetic cases and A01-A10.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop on any binding drift, gate failure, real-data or task-outcome access, trainable parameter or final-task shortcut.
experiment_design.resource_budget: CPU-only tiny tensors; future canary must freeze a short timeout and output under artifacts.local/evidence/assistive-geometry/.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: The F1 graph already declares continuous factor tensors and the byte-frozen F0 reducer already consumes continuous factor frames; the missing seam is deterministic geometry, calibration and component aggregation rather than a learned task head.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Only the tensor-to-frame adapter is introduced; F1 schema, F0 reducer, model absence, data absence and task outcome remain unchanged.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates interface/mechanics feasibility from the still-unsatisfied factor-supervision question.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Eight tiny synthetic tensor cases covering nominal, orientation, missing depth, uncertainty, support invalidity, receipt mismatch, split and merge.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: A01-A10 conjunctive PASS with field coverage 1.0 and zero monotonicity violations.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any required field is unmapped, any invalid evidence is imputed, any uncertainty strengthens evidence, orientation changes task semantics, or output is nondeterministic.
hypotheses.cost: Static protocol work only in this lock; no adapter execution.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Negligible static JSON and mutation tests.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not authorize implementation if the static protocol or any mutation test is invalid.
hypotheses.selection_reason: This is the smallest shared blocker whose removal benefits both Assistive Geometry F1 and any later real TARO O0R without training a model.

successor_policy.successor_scope: Zero-parameter implementation plus the frozen synthetic canary only.

claim_ceiling: This lock freezes only the deterministic F1-tensor to F0-frame adapter schema, operations, synthetic fixture and mutation gates. It does not implement or execute the adapter and cannot establish factor learnability, real factor headroom, task utility, model, device, product or safety evidence.
